correctness.rationale: The fixed-clock conditional law is exactly \(S_m/\sqrt m\). Exponential tilting with \(\theta=\operatorname{arctanh}(x/\sqrt m)\), uniform tilted Berry–Esseen and the rate expansion \(I(z)=z^2/2+z^4/12+O(z^6)\) give the finite-sample quartic profile for all sequences \(x/m^{1/4}\) with finite limit, including the lattice boundary. The verified Gaussian comparison theorem supplies an integrable constant relative-tail envelope for all clock values. The published positive a.s. Mittag–Leffler limit for \(K_n/n^p\) then permits dominated convergence and establishes sharpness. Exact-rational recursions and numerical finite tests pass 2088 assertions, but are not treated as proof of infinite limits. All fixed \(p\in(0,1)\), \(\delta\in(0,1)\), finite c and upper/lower tails are covered.
